sections.title: Service dialogues: request, clarify, confirm: meaning and form
body: Goal: Handle a short service encounter by stating a need, checking a detail and confirming the outcome.
Core vocabulary: kundtjänst, ett kvitto, bekräfta. Key phrases: Jag skulle vilja ändra min bokning. · Jag undrar om det finns en senare tid. · Kan du bekräfta den nya tiden?

Use Jag skulle vilja … for a polite request, Jag undrar om … for an indirect question and Menar du att …? to check understanding. An indirect yes/no question after om keeps statement order: Jag undrar om det finns en senare tid.
Say the examples aloud, notice the pattern, and then change one detail rather than memorising a fixed script.

examples.fi: Jag skulle vilja ändra min bokning.
examples.en: I would like to change my booking.

examples.fi: Jag undrar om det finns en senare tid.
examples.en: I wonder whether there is a later appointment.

examples.fi: Kan du bekräfta den nya tiden?
examples.en: Can you confirm the new time?

sections.title: Register, evidence and independent use
body: Register model: “Jag skulle vilja ändra min bokning.” is a polite service language way to express “I would like to change my booking.”.
For listening and reading, answer from a specific word or phrase. For speaking and writing, make the recipient, purpose and next action clear.
Attempt the task before using the model. Improve one high-impact feature, then perform it again with the transfer condition.

assignment.title: Four-skill task and transfer
assignment.instructions:
LISTEN: First listen without a transcript. Answer: How will the customer receive confirmation? Replay once and identify the exact words that prove the answer.

READ: Read for purpose and evidence. Answer: When is changing the appointment free? Mark the shortest phrase that supports your choice.

SPEAK: Role-play a service call: state what you need, ask about one alternative, check a detail you did not hear and confirm the result. Make a first attempt, check clarity and repeat once.

WRITE: Write a follow-up message after a service call. Record the agreed time, the price or condition, and ask for confirmation. Check reader, purpose, required details and next action.

TRANSFER: The preferred time is unavailable and the offered alternative conflicts with work; negotiate one more option.

BETWEEN LESSON · Optional, 5 minutes: retrieve the three key phrases without looking, then use one in a new sentence.
